verdict.rationale: Kick documents components a close would touch: monthly bank reconciliation, period locks applied after the accountant finishes review, and an accrual ledger on the Plus plan. Nothing in the evidence describes a close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs as tasks. The MCP/CLI note about automating month-end checks is a developer building block, not a native checklist, so these are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
